question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a gold ball, Bob has a pink ball, Claire has a teal ball, Dave has a silver ball, and Eve has a black ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Bob and Alice swap balls. Then, Dave and Claire swap balls. Then, Eve and Claire swap balls. Then, Claire and Dave swap balls. Finally, Claire and Eve swap balls. At the end of the game, Eve has the
Options:
(A) gold ball
(B) pink ball
(C) teal ball
(D) silver ball
(E) black ball
solution:
Ball colors in player order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve):
Initial: (gold, pink, teal, silver, black)
1. Bob and Alice swap: (pink, gold, teal, silver, black)
2. Dave and Claire swap: (pink, gold, silver, teal, black)
3. Eve and Claire swap: (pink, gold, black, teal, silver)
4. Claire and Dave swap: (pink, gold, teal, black, silver)
5. Claire and Eve swap: (pink, gold, silver, black, teal)
Eve has the teal ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
